criteria: Datasets must be named as experimental, training, evaluation, qualitative, or newly introduced data in an official paper or project source. Citation-only and related-work mentions are excluded. Public adoption counts only unique, visible arXiv papers that use a dataset for training or evaluation and are scope-audited as direct dynamic-Gaussian work; eight such papers make a dataset common, two to seven emerging, one observed, and introduced-only records remain metadata-only. Venue-only evidence remains in the per-paper audit and SQLite database but does not change public counts.
